text: DSH Auto Review Panel 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的只读 Auto Review 展示插件。它通过宿主审查记录通道与右侧栏标签，把工具调用的判定、风险等级、理由和关联的执行结果呈现在当前会话中。用户可以按风险、结论、工具和时间筛选记录，打开详情查看请求片段，并浏览按会话保存、重启后恢复的历史；插件还提供历史留存配置页。适合需要了解自动审查为何放行或拒绝工具调用的 DSH 用户。使用需启用官方 Auto Review，并运行受支持版本的 DSH。

DSH Auto Review Panel adds a read-only tab to the DSH web sidebar for Auto Review verdicts, risks, reasons, and tool outcomes. Filter by risk, decision, tool, or time. Per-session history returns after restart; retention is configurable. Requires the official reviewer and a supported DSH release.

Show me why Auto Review allowed or denied a tool call in DSH.
I need a sidebar to filter review history by risk, verdict, tool, and time.
DSH Auto Review Panel 的功能「审查判定侧栏」：在 web 客户端右侧栏展示 Auto Review 记录，并可按风险、结论、工具和时间筛选。

@dsh-electron/dsh-auto-review-panel README · 项目简介：DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的 Auto 权限预设由 Auto Review 审查器在后台裁决每一次工具调用——允许、放行还是拒绝——但这些裁决对使用者几乎不可见：调用被放行时悄无声息，被拒绝时只有一条结果消息。

本插件是一个不修改上游任何代码的外部扩展，给 Auto Review 装上**一块看得见的面板**：把审查器的判定、风险等级与依据呈现在侧栏里，让"这次调用为什么被放行/拒绝"不再是一个只能从会话消息里猜的黑盒。

@dsh-electron/dsh-auto-review-panel README · 项目简介：- **只读呈现，不改裁决**：面板是审查状态的一个 UI/传输面，不是第二个审查器。授权策略、风险分级与来源分类完全由官方 Auto Review 负责（语义见[上游调研](./docs/reference/upstream-auto-review.md)），本插件不裁决、不拦截、不重算任何调用——审查内容经 `llm/stream` 的只读观察接缝捕获——指纹匹配不上即不记录，绝不误报（[ADR-0003](./docs/decisions/ADR-0003-review-record-capture.md)）。
- **历史按会话持久化**：审查记录落盘到 `<DSH_HOME>/auto-review-panel/v1/`（默认 `~/.dsh/auto-review-panel/v1/`），`dsh` 重启后按会话恢复；Auto Review 已停用、或会话不再用 Auto preset 时历史照常展示；未关联记录（上游 `deny+never` 拦截的批次）在任何会话视图恒可见。默认不限量，留存上限与清理入口在插件管理页本插件条目的配置页（见[用户指南](./docs/guide/README.md#审查历史存在哪里存多久)与 [ADR-0004](./docs/decisions/ADR-0004-review-record-persistence.md)）。
- **host/client 分半**：宿主半部承载审查状态的读取通道，浏览器半部把它渲染进侧栏；两半之间走 DSH 的 Connection 通道，不私开 HTTP 面。
- **不配等于没装**：宿主 DSH 版本不在支持清单上、或核心包混装时，插件行不启动，组合退化为"没装这个插件"——这是刻意的 fail-closed，见 [ADR-0001](./docs/decisions/ADR-0001-dsh-compat-contract.md)。

**从源码构建 / 贡献**：Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24`，pnpm `11.25.0`（建议经 corepack 启用）；开发 pin 的 DSH 为 `0.2.2-alpha.2`。

**运行平台**：macOS、Linux、Windows——面板是 UI 面，无平台特定执行语义；Windows CI 腿默认停放，面板出现平台相关行为时再由仓库变量 `DSH_WINDOWS_CI` 启用。

@dsh-electron/dsh-auto-review-panel README · 安装：插件尚未发布到 npm。当前仅支持从本地源码安装：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/cherrchen/dsh-auto-review-panel.git
cd dsh-auto-review-panel
export CI=true
pnpm install

> [!TIP]
> `dsh` 不在 PATH 里时（例如用源码仓库跑 DSH），把命令里的 `dsh` 换成 `pnpm dsh`。

**前置条件**：本插件只观察已有审查器的裁决，自身不审查。要看到内容，需先在插件管理器启用官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review`（它随安装附带、默认关闭）；若当前安装未附带，再显式安装与宿主 DSH 一致的精确版本，勿用滞后的 `latest`，并让会话选择 Auto preset——两者缺一，面板将恒为空。

1. 先读 [`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md)（仓库级规则）与[开发工作流](./docs/development/plugin-development-workflow.md)（环境、命令、运行时支持矩阵、升级流程）。
2. 从 `main` 拉分支；提交信息遵循 conventional commits（`feat` / `fix` / `perf` / `refactor` + scope），参见现有历史。
3. PR 前本地必须全部通过：`pnpm lint`、`pnpm typecheck`、`pnpm build`、`pnpm test`、`pnpm docs:check`、`pnpm smoke`（CI 按同序执行，先 build 后 test）。
4. 影响行为的变更需同批更新 `docs/` 下的对应文档；README 保持中英双语同步；有取舍的工程决策请新增 ADR。
5. 硬约束：**不修改上游仓库（deepseek-harness）任何包**；插件只做 out-of-tree 扩展。

@dsh-electron/dsh-auto-review-panel README · 已知限制：- 记录以**明文** JSONL 落盘在 `<DSH_HOME>/auto-review-panel/v1/`：含审查请求全文与推理原文，不加密、不上传——共享机器请按本地敏感文件对待；没有"关闭持久化"开关（面板的读路径经同一存储）。
- 不做跨会话历史浏览：无会话视图只显示当前进程内存里的记录；未关联记录（没有 `correlation.callId` 锚）如实显示在「未关联」组、无宿主结局佐证。
- 支持矩阵是精确版本 allowlist：宿主版本不在清单上、或核心包混装了不同版本时，被门禁的 `auto-review-panel` 行**不启动**，组合退化为"没装这个插件"（[ADR-0001](./docs/decisions/ADR-0001-dsh-compat-contract.md)）。
- 官方 Auto Review 不提供专用的面板数据源接口：审查判定与原因需要从宿主侧的既有接缝读取，上游一旦改变这些接缝的形状，只能由适配层或升级车道发现——本插件不承诺跨版本的语义直通（[上游调研](./docs/reference/upstream-auto-review.md)）。

@dsh-electron/dsh-auto-review-panel README · Overview：Under DSH (DeepSeek Harness)'s Auto permission preset, the Auto Review reviewer adjudicates every tool call in the background — allow, pass, or deny — yet those verdicts are nearly invisible to the user: an approved call goes through silently, and a denied one leaves only a result message.

@dsh-electron/dsh-auto-review-panel README · Overview：This plugin is an out-of-tree extension that modifies no upstream code and gives Auto Review **a visible panel**: it surfaces the reviewer's verdicts, risk levels, and rationale in the sidebar, so "why was this call approved or denied" is no longer a black box you can only guess at from session messages.

@dsh-electron/dsh-auto-review-panel README · Overview：- **Read-only presentation, no verdict changes**: the panel is a UI/transport surface over the review state, not a second reviewer. Authorization policy, risk grading, and source classification belong entirely to the official Auto Review (see the [upstream survey](./docs/reference/upstream-auto-review.md)); this plugin never decides, intercepts, or recomputes a call — review content is captured through a read-only `llm/stream` observation seam — a fingerprint miss simply records nothing and never fabricates ([ADR-0003](./docs/decisions/ADR-0003-review-record-capture.md)).
- **Per-session persisted history**: review records land on disk under `<DSH_HOME>/auto-review-panel/v1/` (`~/.dsh/auto-review-panel/v1/` by default) and are restored per session across `dsh` restarts; they stay visible after Auto Review is disabled or the session leaves the Auto preset, and uncorrelated records (the batch upstream stops with `deny + never`) remain visible in every session view. Retention is unlimited by default; limits and clearing live on this plugin's row configuration page in the plugin manager (see the [user guide](./docs/guide/README.en.m

@dsh-electron/dsh-auto-review-panel README · Overview：The first release `v0.1.0` is ready: review-record capture, host-outcome evidence, the sidebar.right panel, and per-session persistence have all landed, verified by `smoke:live` in a real composition against the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review@0.2.1-rc.2` (npm `next`) — including on-disk writes and restart recovery. Progress and release state live in the [roadmap progress ledger](./docs/plans/completed/2026-10-20-auto-review-panel.md#进度总账).

| DSH line | Supported releases |
| --- | --- |
| `0.2.1` | `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.2-alpha.2` |

When the host's DSH release is not listed, or `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` packages disagree on a version, the plugin does not start and behaves exactly as if it were not installed.

@dsh-electron/dsh-auto-review-panel README · Requirements：**Building from source / contributing**: Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24`, pnpm `11.25.0` (enable via corepack); the development pin is DSH `0.2.2-alpha.2`.

**Platforms**: macOS, Linux, Windows — the panel is a UI surface with no platform-specific execution semantics; the Windows CI lane is parked by default and can be enabled through the `DSH_WINDOWS_CI` repository variable when the panel grows platform-dependent behavior.

> [!TIP]

@dsh-electron/dsh-auto-review-panel README · Installation：**Prerequisite**: this plugin only visualizes decisions an existing reviewer already made — it reviews nothing itself. For the panel to show anything, enable the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review` first (it ships with the installation, off by default); if your installation does not carry it, explicitly install the exact version matching your DSH host — not the stale `latest`, and run the session under the Auto preset — missing either leaves the panel permanently empty.

@dsh-electron/dsh-auto-review-panel README · Contributing：1. Read [`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md) (repository rules) and the [development workflow](./docs/development/plugin-development-workflow.md) (environment, commands, runtime support matrix, upgrade flow) first.

@dsh-electron/dsh-auto-review-panel README · Known limitations：- Records persist as **plaintext** JSONL under `<DSH_HOME>/auto-review-panel/v1/`: the full review request text and reasoning are on disk, unencrypted and never uploaded — treat them as local sensitive files on shared machines; there is no "persistence off" switch (the panel's read path goes through the same store).
- No cross-session history browsing: the session-less view shows only the current process's in-memory records; records without a `correlation.callId` anchor stay honestly in the "uncorrelated" group with no host-outcome evidence.
- The support matrix is an exact-version allowlist: when the host release is unlisted, or core packages mix releases, the gated `auto-review-panel` row **does not start** and the composition degrades to "plugin not installed" ([ADR-0001](./docs/decisions/ADR-0001-dsh-compat-contract.md)).
- The official Auto Review exposes no dedicated data feed for a panel: verdicts and rationale must be read through existing host-side seams, and if upstream changes those seams' shape, only the adaptation layer or the upgrade lane can notice — this plugin makes no cross-version semantic guarantee (
